name: serve_logo
note: NEWLY DISCOVERED (not in the original 11+4 known issues): 404s despite the file existing at the project root. main.py mounts StaticFiles at /static (line 477) BEFORE include_router(platform) (line 499) -- the mount's prefix match wins, so platform.py's dedicated @router.get('/static/magti_logo.png') (whose own docstring claims it 'intercepts the request before it falls through to the StaticFiles mount') never actually runs. Dead code, logo broken.
